headword: {家庭学習|かていがくしゅう}

definitions.gloss: home study; studying at home; home learning
definitions.explanation: Academic study done at home, including homework, self-study, and review outside of school. Often discussed in the context of children's education and study habits.

notes:
Combines ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (home, household) and ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (study, learning). A standard term in Japanese education, frequently used by schools, parents, and in educational policy. Schools often distribute {家庭学習|かていがくしゅう}⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧ (home study notebooks) for students to record their daily study.
